Strings.addon.title: Material Sources
Strings.addon.description: Where to find each material, starting with what you're running low on: how full you are of every raw, manufactured, encoded, Guardian and Thargoid material, where each comes from, and what a trader would take for it.
Strings.js.no_mats: Waiting for your materials: the game lists them when you load into the game.
Strings.ui.low_tip: Running low: under this share of a material's cap
Strings.ui.note: General guidance: what drops where changes with game updates and system states.
Strings.src.surface: Surface prospecting in an SRV: shoot mineral outcrops and pick up the fragments. The system map shows how much of each element a body has: pick bodies rich in it
Strings.src.brain: Brain trees (found near Guardian sites): shooting them drops high-grade raw materials
Strings.src.shards: Crystalline shard fields on some planets (e.g. HIP 36601, Outotz LS-K d8-3): shoot shards in an SRV for high-grade raw materials
Strings.src.mining: Laser mining in asteroid rings: raw materials come with the fragments
Strings.src.hge: High Grade Emissions signal sources: high-grade manufactured salvage. Which one depends on the system: its state (boom, war, outbreak…) and allegiance
Strings.src.ships: Destroyed ships drop manufactured materials: bigger and harder targets drop better ones
Strings.src.uss: Degraded Emissions and combat aftermath signal sources
Strings.src.salvage: Crashed ships and wreckage on planet surfaces
Strings.src.wake: Scan high-energy wakes (ships jumping out of a system) with an FSD Wake Scanner
Strings.src.scan: Scan ships with a ship scanner, especially big and well-shielded ones
Strings.src.scan_low: Shoot down ships' shields and scan them as they cycle
Strings.src.beacon: Scan nav beacons and data beacons in systems
Strings.src.datapoint: Data points and terminals at surface settlements and installations
Strings.src.encodeduss: Encoded Emissions signal sources (and Degraded Emissions for lower grades)
Strings.src.missions: Mission rewards: many missions let you pick materials as the reward
Strings.src.trader: A material trader: trade other materials of the same category for it
Strings.src.gsite: Guardian structures: power up the pylons and pick up the technology parts around the site
Strings.src.sentinel: Guardian Sentinels: destroy them at Guardian structures and collect what they drop
Strings.src.gterminal: Data terminals at Guardian structures (Guardian blueprint fragments)
Strings.src.obelisk: Obelisks at Guardian ruins: scan them with the right relic or casket in your SRV
Strings.src.tships: Thargoid ships and their wrecks: destroyed Scouts and Interceptors, and Thargoid surface sites
Strings.src.tscan: Scan Thargoid ships and objects with a composition or xeno scanner
Strings.src.tsite: Thargoid surface sites and the wreckage in Thargoid systems
Strings.src.hge_outbreak: High Grade Emissions in systems in an Outbreak
Strings.src.hge_war: High Grade Emissions in systems at War or in Civil War
Strings.src.hge_unrest: High Grade Emissions in systems in Civil Unrest
Strings.src.hge_empire: High Grade Emissions in Empire systems
Strings.src.hge_federation: High Grade Emissions in Federation systems
Strings.src.hge_boom: High Grade Emissions in systems in a Boom
